title.sk: Zemiakový gratin dauphinois

description.sk: Francúzske tenké plátky zemiakov pečené v smotane s cesnakom do zlatista.
description.en: French thinly sliced potatoes baked in cream with garlic until golden.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 170 °C. Zapekaciu misu potri prekrojeným strúčikom cesnaku a vymasti maslom. Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na tenké plátky asi 3 mm – neumývaj ich, škrob omáčku zahustí.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 170 °C. Rub a baking dish with a cut garlic clove and grease it with butter. Peel the potatoes and slice them thinly, about 3 mm; do not rinse them, as the starch thickens the sauce.

steps.sk: V hrnci zohrej smotanu s mliekom, prelisovaným cesnakom, tymianom, muškátovým orieškom, soľou a korením takmer do varu. Pridaj zemiaky a var na miernom ohni 5 minút za opatrného miešania, kým tekutina trochu nezhustne.
steps.en: Heat the cream and milk with the crushed garlic, thyme, nutmeg, salt and pepper in a pan until almost boiling. Add the potatoes and simmer gently for 5 minutes, stirring carefully, until the liquid thickens a little.

steps.sk: Zemiaky aj so smotanou prelož do misy a uhlaď ich, aby boli rovnomerne ponorené. Podľa chuti posyp syrom.
steps.en: Transfer the potatoes and cream to the dish and level them so they are evenly covered. Sprinkle with cheese if you like.

steps.sk: Peč 60 až 70 minút, kým nie je povrch zlatohnedý a nôž prejde zemiakmi bez odporu. Ak povrch hnedne príliš rýchlo, prikry ho alobalom.
steps.en: Bake for 60 to 70 minutes until golden brown on top and a knife passes through the potatoes without resistance. If the top browns too fast, cover with foil.

steps.sk: Nechaj gratin 10 minút odpočívať, aby sa smotana usadila. Podávaj ako hlavné jedlo so šalátom alebo ako prílohu k mäsu.
steps.en: Rest the gratin for 10 minutes so the cream sets. Serve as a main with a salad or as a side to meat.

title.sk: Provensálska rybacia polievka

description.sk: Polievka inšpirovaná bujabézou: treska a krevety v paradajkovom vývare s feniklom a pomarančom.
description.en: A bouillabaisse-style soup: cod and prawns in a tomato broth with fennel and orange.

steps.sk: Fenikel a cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké plátky, cesnak nasekaj, zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky asi 1,5 cm. V hrnci zohrej olej a fenikel s cibuľou opekaj na strednom ohni 8 minút, kým nezmäknú.
steps.en: Slice the fennel and onion thinly, chop the garlic and peel and dice the potatoes into roughly 1.5 cm cubes. Heat the oil in a pot and fry the fennel and onion over a medium heat for 8 minutes until soft.

steps.sk: Pridaj cesnak a tymian, po minúte podlej vínom a nechaj ho odpariť. Pridaj paradajky, zemiaky, 1 liter vody, bujón a pásik pomarančovej kôry a var 15 minút, kým zemiaky nezmäknú.
steps.en: Add the garlic and thyme, after a minute pour in the wine and let it evaporate. Add the tomatoes, potatoes, 1 litre of water, the stock cube and a strip of orange zest and simmer for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.

steps.sk: Rybu nakrájaj na kúsky veľkosti sústa. Vlož ju do polievky a var na miernom ohni 4 minúty, potom pridaj krevety a var ešte 2 až 3 minúty, kým nezružovejú a ryba sa nerozpadá na lupienky.
steps.en: Cut the fish into bite-sized pieces. Add it to the soup and simmer gently for 4 minutes, then add the prawns and simmer for 2 to 3 more minutes until they turn pink and the fish flakes.

steps.sk: Pomarančovú kôru vylov a polievku dochuť soľou. Chlieb opeč a podávaj ho k polievke – vo Francúzsku sa natiera cesnakovou majonézou a namáča do vývaru.
steps.en: Remove the orange zest and season the soup with salt. Toast the bread and serve it alongside; in France it is spread with garlic mayonnaise and dunked in the broth.

title.sk: Tian – pečená provensálska zelenina

description.sk: Kolieska cukety, baklažánu a paradajok naukladané v rade a upečené s bylinkami.
description.en: Rounds of courgette, aubergine and tomato arranged in rows and baked with herbs.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C. Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska a cesnak nasekaj. Opeč ich na 2 lyžiciach oleja 8 minút do mäkka a rozotri na dno okrúhlej alebo oválnej zapekacej misy.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Slice the onions thinly into half-moons and chop the garlic. Fry them in 2 tablespoons of oil for 8 minutes until soft and spread over the base of a round or oval baking dish.

steps.sk: Cuketu, baklažán a paradajky nakrájaj na kolieska hrubé asi 5 mm – podobne veľké, aby sa pekne ukladali. Ak je baklažán hrubší ako cuketa, kolieska rozpoľ.
steps.en: Slice the courgettes, aubergine and tomatoes into rounds about 5 mm thick, of similar size so they stack neatly. If the aubergine is much wider than the courgette, halve its slices.

steps.sk: Kolieska ukladaj na cibuľu striedavo a nastojato, tesne vedľa seba v sústredných kruhoch alebo radoch. Polej zvyšným olejom, posyp tymianom, rozmarínom, soľou a korením.
steps.en: Stand the rounds upright on the onions, alternating them and packing them tightly in concentric circles or rows. Drizzle with the remaining oil and sprinkle with the thyme, rosemary, salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Prikry alobalom a peč 30 minút, potom alobal odstráň a peč ďalších 25 až 30 minút, kým zelenina nie je mäkká a okraje koliesok jemne opečené. Ak chceš, na posledných 10 minút posyp kozím syrom.
steps.en: Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake for another 25 to 30 minutes until the vegetables are soft and the edges lightly browned. If you like, crumble goat cheese on top for the last 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Podávaj teplý alebo vlažný s chlebom na vytieranie šťavy. Tian vydrží v chladničke 3 dni a je výborný aj studený.
steps.en: Serve warm or lukewarm with bread to mop up the juices. The tian keeps in the fridge for 3 days and is lovely cold too.

title.sk: Teplý šalát s kozím syrom na hrianke
title.en: Warm goat cheese salad on toast

description.sk: Francúzska klasika: zapečený kozí syr na hriankach s medom na listovom šaláte.
description.en: A French classic: grilled goat cheese on toast with honey over leafy salad.

steps.sk: Rúru zapni na gril alebo na 220 °C s horným ohrevom. Bagetu nakrájaj šikmo na 4 hrubšie plátky a kozí syr na 4 kolieska. Na každý plátok chleba polož koliesko syra.
steps.en: Turn on the oven grill or heat the oven to 220 °C with top heat. Slice the baguette diagonally into 4 thick slices and the goat cheese into 4 rounds. Put a round of cheese on each slice of bread.

steps.sk: Syr pokvapkaj medom a posyp tymianom. Zapekaj 5 až 7 minút, kým syr nezmäkne, nezačne bublať a na povrchu nezozlatne.
steps.en: Drizzle the cheese with honey and sprinkle with thyme. Grill for 5 to 7 minutes until the cheese softens, bubbles and turns golden on top.

steps.sk: Medzitým vyšľahaj olej s octom, horčicou a štipkou soli na dresing. Šalát umy, osuš a natrhaj, premiešaj s rukolou a dresingom. Orechy opraž na suchej panvici 3 minúty.
steps.en: Meanwhile whisk the oil with the vinegar, mustard and a pinch of salt for the dressing. Wash, dry and tear the lettuce and toss with the arugula and dressing. Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Šalát rozdeľ na taniere, navrch polož horúce hrianky so syrom a posyp orechmi. Podávaj hneď, kým je syr teplý a krémový.
steps.en: Divide the salad between plates, top with the hot cheese toasts and scatter with the walnuts. Serve straight away while the cheese is warm and creamy.

title.sk: Quiche s pórom a kozím syrom

description.sk: Krehký koláč s dusenými pórom, kozím syrom a vaječno-smotanovou plnkou.
description.en: A shortcrust tart with soft leeks, goat cheese and an egg and cream filling.

note.sk: 100 g do cesta, 20 g na pór
note.en: 100 g for the pastry, 20 g for the leeks
1 for the pastry, 3 for the filling

steps.sk: Múku so štipkou soli a 100 g studeného masla rozotri prstami na drobenku, pridaj 1 vajce a lyžicu studenej vody a rýchlo vypracuj cesto. Zabaľ ho do fólie a daj na 30 minút do chladničky.
steps.en: Rub the flour, a pinch of salt and 100 g of cold butter into crumbs with your fingertips, add 1 egg and a spoonful of cold water and quickly bring together into a dough. Wrap in film and chill for 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Pór prekroj pozdĺžne, dôkladne umy medzi vrstvami od piesku a nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska. Dus ho na zvyšnom masle s tymianom pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 10 minút do mäkka a nechaj vychladnúť.
steps.en: Halve the leeks lengthways, wash thoroughly between the layers to remove grit and slice thinly into half-moons. Cook them in the remaining butter with the thyme, covered, over a low heat for 10 minutes until soft, then cool.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C. Cesto rozvaľkaj a vylož ním formu s priemerom 24 cm. Prepichaj ho vidličkou, prikry papierom, zaťaž suchou fazuľou a peč 15 minút, potom papier odstráň a peč ešte 5 minút.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Roll out the pastry and line a 24 cm tin. Prick it with a fork, cover with paper, weigh down with dried beans and bake for 15 minutes, then remove the paper and bake for 5 more minutes.

steps.sk: Na predpečené cesto rozlož pór a rozdrobený kozí syr. Vajcia rozšľahaj so smotanou, muškátovým orieškom, zvyšnou soľou a korením a zalej nimi plnku.
steps.en: Spread the leeks and crumbled goat cheese over the part-baked case. Beat the eggs with the cream, nutmeg, the remaining salt and the pepper and pour over the filling.

steps.sk: Zníž teplotu na 170 °C a peč 30 až 35 minút, kým plnka nestuhne a v strede sa už netrasie. Nechaj quiche 10 minút vychladnúť. Je dobrý teplý aj studený a v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Lower the oven to 170 °C and bake for 30 to 35 minutes until the filling has set and no longer wobbles in the middle. Let the quiche cool for 10 minutes. It is good warm or cold and keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Kura so 40 strúčikmi cesnaku

description.sk: Kuracie stehná dusené s celými strúčikmi cesnaku, ktoré zmäknú na sladkú pastu.
description.en: Chicken thighs braised with whole garlic cloves that turn into a sweet, spreadable paste.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C. Stehná osuš, osoľ a okoreň. Cesnak rozober na strúčiky, ale nešúp ich – v šupke sa dusia vo vlastnej šťave a nezhoria.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Pat the chicken dry and season with salt and pepper. Separate the garlic into cloves but do not peel them; in their skins they steam in their own juice and do not burn.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci vhodnom do rúry rozpáľ olej a stehná opekaj kožou nadol na strednom až vysokom ohni 6 minút, kým koža nie je zlatohnedá a chrumkavá. Otoč ich a opeč ešte 2 minúty.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide ovenproof pot and fry the chicken skin side down over a medium-high heat for 6 minutes until the skin is golden brown and crisp. Turn and brown for 2 more minutes.

steps.sk: Okolo stehien rozsyp strúčiky cesnaku, tymian a rozmarín, prilej víno a 100 ml vody s bujónom. Prikry pokrievkou a peč v rúre 45 minút.
steps.en: Scatter the garlic cloves, thyme and rosemary around the chicken and pour in the wine and 100 ml of water with the stock. Cover and bake in the oven for 45 minutes.

steps.sk: Odkry hrniec a peč ešte 10 minút, aby koža znova dochrumkavela. Mäso je hotové, keď sa ľahko oddeľuje od kosti a šťava je číra; cesnak má byť úplne mäkký.
steps.en: Uncover and bake for 10 more minutes so the skin crisps up again. The chicken is done when it comes away easily from the bone and the juices run clear; the garlic should be completely soft.

steps.sk: Podávaj s opečeným chlebom: strúčiky cesnaku vytlač zo šupky na chlieb a natri ako maslo, namáčaj do šťavy. Chuť je jemná a sladká, nie ostrá.
steps.en: Serve with toasted bread: squeeze the garlic cloves out of their skins onto the bread, spread like butter and dip into the juices. The flavour is mild and sweet, not sharp.

title.sk: Kuracia blanquette s hubami

description.sk: Francúzske biele ragú z kuracieho mäsa, mrkvy a šampiňónov v smotanovej omáčke.
description.en: A French white stew of chicken, carrots and mushrooms in a cream sauce.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kúsky asi 4 cm, mrkvu na kolieska a cibuľu na štvrtiny. Daj ich do hrnca, zalej 700 ml vody s bujónom, pridaj bobkový list a tymian a priveď do varu. Penu zober.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into roughly 4 cm pieces, the carrots into rounds and the onion into quarters. Put them in a pot, cover with 700 ml of water with the stock cube, add the bay leaf and thyme and bring to the boil. Skim off the foam.

steps.sk: Var na miernom ohni 30 minút, kým mäso nie je mäkké. Mäso ani zeleninu neopekaj – blanquette má zostať biela a jemná. Medzitým uvar ryžu.
steps.en: Simmer gently for 30 minutes until the chicken is tender. Do not brown the meat or vegetables; a blanquette should stay pale and delicate. Meanwhile cook the rice.

steps.sk: Šampiňóny rozštvrť a podus ich na polovici masla 5 minút. V inom hrnci rozpusti zvyšné maslo, vmiešaj múku a 1 minútu ju opekaj bez hnednutia, potom za stáleho šľahania prilej 500 ml vývaru z mäsa.
steps.en: Quarter the mushrooms and cook them in half the butter for 5 minutes. In another pan melt the remaining butter, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute without browning, then whisk in 500 ml of the cooking liquid.

steps.sk: Var omáčku 5 minút, kým nezhustne. Žĺtok rozšľahaj so smotanou, vmiešaj do omáčky a zohrievaj na miernom ohni minútu – nesmie vrieť, žĺtok by sa zrazil. Dochuť citrónovou šťavou.
steps.en: Simmer the sauce for 5 minutes until it thickens. Beat the yolk with the cream, stir into the sauce and heat gently for a minute; it must not boil or the yolk curdles. Season with lemon juice.

steps.sk: Do omáčky pridaj mäso, mrkvu a huby, bobkový list a cibuľu vyber. Podávaj s ryžou. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni, zohrievaj ju pomaly.
steps.en: Add the chicken, carrots and mushrooms to the sauce, discarding the bay leaf and onion. Serve with the rice. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days; reheat it gently.

title.sk: Cibuľový koláč s olivami (pissaladière)

description.sk: Provensálsky koláč z kysnutého cesta s karamelizovanou cibuľou a olivami.
description.en: A Provençal yeasted tart topped with caramelised onions and olives.

steps.sk: Droždie s cukrom rozmiešaj v 180 ml vlažnej vody, pridaj múku, polovicu soli a 2 lyžice oleja a mies 8 minút, kým cesto nie je hladké. Prikry ho a nechaj 1 hodinu kysnúť.
steps.en: Stir the yeast and sugar into 180 ml of lukewarm water, add the flour, half the salt and 2 tablespoons of oil and knead for 8 minutes until smooth. Cover and leave to rise for 1 hour.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska. V širokom hrnci zohrej zvyšný olej, pridaj cibuľu, tymian a zvyšnú soľ a dus ju pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 40 minút za občasného miešania, kým nie je mäkká, sladká a zlatistá.
steps.en: Slice the onions thinly into half-moons. Heat the remaining oil in a wide pan, add the onions, thyme and remaining salt and cook, covered, over a low heat for 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft, sweet and golden.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Cesto rozvaľkaj na plech s papierom do obdĺžnika asi 35 × 25 cm a hrúbky 5 mm. Rozotri naň vychladnutú cibuľu, okraj 1 cm nechaj voľný.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Roll the dough on a lined baking tray into a rectangle of about 35 × 25 cm, 5 mm thick. Spread over the cooled onions, leaving a 1 cm border.

steps.sk: Navrch rozlož olivy a kapary do mriežky. Peč 20 až 25 minút, kým okraje nie sú zlatohnedé a spodok chrumkavý.
steps.en: Arrange the olives and capers on top in a grid. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until the edges are golden brown and the base is crisp.

steps.sk: Nakrájaj na štvorce a podávaj teplý alebo pri izbovej teplote, so zeleným šalátom. Vydrží do druhého dňa.
steps.en: Cut into squares and serve warm or at room temperature with a green salad. It keeps until the next day.

title.sk: Losos s maslovou omáčkou a zelenou fazuľkou
title.en: Salmon with butter sauce and green beans

description.sk: Opečený losos s chrumkavou kožou, francúzskou maslovou omáčkou a fazuľkou.
description.en: Seared salmon with crisp skin, a French butter sauce and green beans.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na kúsky a uvar v osolenej vode 15 minút doměkka. Fazuľku očisti a posledných 5 minút ju var spolu so zemiakmi, aby zostala chrumkavá a jasne zelená.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, cut into chunks and boil in salted water for 15 minutes until tender. Trim the green beans and boil them with the potatoes for the last 5 minutes so they stay crisp and bright green.

steps.sk: Na omáčku daj do malého hrnčeka nadrobno nasekanú šalotku, víno a ocot a var na strednom ohni 4 minúty, kým nezostanú asi 2 lyžice tekutiny.
steps.en: For the sauce put the finely chopped shallot, wine and vinegar in a small pan and boil over a medium heat for 4 minutes until only about 2 tablespoons of liquid remain.

steps.sk: Lososa osuš, osoľ a polož kožou nadol na rozpálenú panvicu s olejom. Peč na strednom ohni 5 minút, kým koža nie je chrumkavá, otoč a peč ešte 2 minúty – stred má zostať ružový a sklovitý.
steps.en: Pat the salmon dry, salt it and place skin side down in a hot oiled pan. Cook over a medium heat for 5 minutes until the skin is crisp, flip and cook for 2 more minutes; the centre should stay pink and glossy.

steps.sk: Hrnček s redukciou daj na najmenší oheň a po kúskoch zašľahaj studené maslo, vždy počkaj, kým sa predchádzajúci kúsok rozpustí. Omáčka má byť krémová a lesklá; nesmie vrieť, inak sa maslo oddelí. Dochuť citrónom.
steps.en: Put the reduction over the lowest heat and whisk in the cold butter piece by piece, waiting until each piece melts before adding the next. The sauce should be creamy and glossy; it must not boil or the butter separates. Add lemon to taste.

steps.sk: Na taniere daj zemiaky s fazuľkou, navrch lososa a polej ho omáčkou. Posyp kôprom a podávaj hneď.
steps.en: Plate the potatoes and beans, top with the salmon and spoon over the sauce. Sprinkle with dill and serve at once.

title.sk: Salmorejo – hustá studená paradajková polievka

description.sk: Andalúzsky krém z paradajok, chleba, cesnaku a olivového oleja s vajcom a šunkou.
description.en: An Andalusian cream of tomatoes, bread, garlic and olive oil topped with egg and ham.

steps.sk: Paradajky umy, odstráň stopky a nakrájaj ich na kúsky. Chlieb nalámaj, odstráň tvrdú kôrku a zalej ho trochou vody, aby zmäkol – stačí 5 minút.
steps.en: Wash the tomatoes, remove the stalks and chop them. Break up the bread, remove the hard crust and moisten it with a little water to soften; 5 minutes is enough.

steps.sk: Paradajky rozmixuj s cesnakom, octom a soľou na pyré. Pridaj vytlačený chlieb a mixuj ďalšie 2 minúty, kým nie je zmes úplne hladká.
steps.en: Blend the tomatoes with the garlic, vinegar and salt into a purée. Add the squeezed-out bread and blend for another 2 minutes until completely smooth.

steps.sk: Pri bežiacom mixéri prilievaj olej tenkým prúdom – polievka zhustne, zosvetlie a bude krémová ako majonéza. Ak chceš úplne hodvábnu, pretlač ju cez sitko. Vychlaď aspoň 1 hodinu.
steps.en: With the blender running, pour in the oil in a thin stream; the soup thickens, turns paler and becomes creamy like mayonnaise. For a silky finish push it through a sieve. Chill for at least 1 hour.

steps.sk: Vajcia uvar natvrdo 10 minút, ošúp a nasekaj. Šunku nakrájaj na drobné prúžky. Salmorejo nalej do misiek a posyp vajcom, šunkou a kvapkou oleja. V chladničke vydrží 2 dni.
steps.en: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then peel and chop them. Cut the ham into thin strips. Pour the salmorejo into bowls and top with the egg, ham and a drop of oil. It keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

title.sk: Fabada – fazuľa s chorizom a slaninou
title.en: Fabada: beans with chorizo and bacon

description.sk: Sýty asturský hrniec bielej fazule s chorizom, slaninou a údenou paprikou.
description.en: A hearty Asturian pot of white beans with chorizo, bacon and smoked paprika.

steps.sk: Chorizo nakrájaj na kolieska hrubé 1 cm, slaninu na kocky a cibuľu nadrobno. V hrnci zohrej olej a slaninu s chorizom opekaj na strednom ohni 5 minút, kým nepustia tuk.
steps.en: Slice the chorizo 1 cm thick, dice the bacon and finely chop the onion. Heat the oil in a pot and fry the bacon and chorizo over a medium heat for 5 minutes until they release their fat.

steps.sk: Pridaj cibuľu a cesnak a opekaj 5 minút do mäkka. Posyp údenou paprikou, krátko premiešaj a hneď pridaj fazuľu, bobkový list a 600 ml vody – bujón netreba, mäso dá dosť chuti.
steps.en: Add the onion and garlic and fry for 5 minutes until soft. Sprinkle with the smoked paprika, stir briefly and immediately add the beans, bay leaf and 600 ml of water; no stock is needed, the meat gives plenty of flavour.

steps.sk: Var na miernom ohni pod pokrievkou 30 minút. Nemiešaj vareškou, aby sa fazuľa nerozpadla – radšej hrncom občas zatras. Niekoľko fazúľ roztlač o stenu hrnca, aby šťava zhustla.
steps.en: Simmer gently, covered, for 30 minutes. Do not stir with a spoon or the beans break; shake the pot now and then instead. Crush a few beans against the side of the pot to thicken the broth.

steps.sk: Bobkový list vyber, ochutnaj – soľ zvyčajne netreba, chorizo a slanina sú slané. Posyp vňaťou a podávaj s chlebom. Na druhý deň je fabada ešte lepšia; dá sa aj zamraziť.
steps.en: Remove the bay leaf and taste; it usually needs no salt, as the chorizo and bacon are salty. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with bread. Fabada is even better the next day and freezes well.

title.sk: Papriky plnené ryžou a tuniakom
title.en: Peppers stuffed with rice and tuna

description.sk: Španielske pečené papriky plnené ryžou s tuniakom, paradajkami a olivami.
description.en: Spanish roasted peppers stuffed with rice, tuna, tomatoes and olives.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C. Paprikám odrež vrchy aj so stopkou a odlož ich, vyber semienka a biele steny. Ryžu uvar v osolenej vode 10 minút, aby bola napoly mäkká, a sceď ju.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Cut the tops off the peppers with the stalks and keep them; remove the seeds and white ribs. Par-boil the rice in salted water for 10 minutes and drain.

steps.sk: Na panvici zohrej olej a nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu opekaj 5 minút, pridaj cesnak a údenú papriku. Vmiešaj polovicu passaty, ryžu, rozdrobeného tuniaka a nakrájané olivy a dochuť soľou.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pan and fry the finely chopped onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and smoked paprika. Stir in half the passata, the rice, the flaked tuna and the sliced olives and season with salt.

steps.sk: Papriky naplň zmesou, prikry ich odloženými vrchmi a postav do zapekacej misy. Okolo nich nalej zvyšnú passatu zriedenú 100 ml vody.
steps.en: Fill the peppers with the mixture, put the tops back on and stand them in a baking dish. Pour the remaining passata, diluted with 100 ml of water, around them.

steps.sk: Prikry alobalom a peč 30 minút, potom alobal odstráň a peč ešte 10 minút, kým papriky nie sú mäkké a jemne opečené. Ryža vnútri dovarí v pare.
steps.en: Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake for 10 more minutes until the peppers are soft and lightly charred. The rice finishes cooking in the steam inside.

steps.sk: Podávaj posypané vňaťou, s omáčkou z misy. Plnené papriky vydržia v chladničke 3 dni a dobre sa zohrievajú.
steps.en: Serve sprinkled with parsley, with the sauce from the dish. The stuffed peppers keep in the fridge for 3 days and reheat well.

title.sk: Zeleninová paella

description.sk: Vegánska paella s paprikou, zelenou fazuľkou, hráškom a paradajkami a chrumkavým spodkom.
description.en: A vegan paella with peppers, green beans, peas and tomatoes and a crisp base.

steps.sk: Papriky nakrájaj na prúžky, fazuľku na kúsky 3 cm, cibuľu a cesnak nadrobno a paradajky nastrúhaj na hrubom strúhadle – šupka zostane v ruke. Bujón rozpusti v 900 ml horúcej vody.
steps.en: Cut the peppers into strips, the green beans into 3 cm pieces and finely chop the onion and garlic; grate the tomatoes on a coarse grater so the skin stays in your hand. Dissolve the stock cube in 900 ml of hot water.

steps.sk: Na širokej panvici zohrej olej a papriku s fazuľkou opekaj na strednom až vysokom ohni 5 minút. Pridaj cibuľu a cesnak a opekaj 3 minúty, potom paradajky, papriku a kurkumu a var 3 minúty, kým zmes nezhustne.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pan and fry the peppers and beans over a medium-high heat for 5 minutes. Add the onion and garlic and fry for 3 minutes, then the tomatoes, paprika and turmeric and cook for 3 minutes until thick.

steps.sk: Vsyp ryžu, premiešaj ju so zeleninou a zalej horúcim vývarom. Rovnomerne ju rozprestri po panvici a odteraz už nemiešaj – na dne sa má vytvoriť chrumkavá vrstva. Var na strednom ohni 10 minút.
steps.en: Add the rice, stir it into the vegetables and pour in the hot stock. Spread the rice evenly across the pan and from now on do not stir; a crisp layer should form on the bottom. Simmer over a medium heat for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Rozsyp hrášok, zníž oheň a var ďalších 8 až 10 minút, kým ryža nevpije tekutinu a nie je mäkká. Na konci zvýš na minútu oheň – keď počuješ jemné praskanie, tvorí sa chrumkavý spodok.
steps.en: Scatter over the peas, lower the heat and cook for another 8 to 10 minutes until the rice has absorbed the liquid and is tender. At the end turn up the heat for a minute; when you hear gentle crackling, the crisp base is forming.

steps.sk: Prikry paellu utierkou a nechaj 5 minút odpočívať. Podávaj priamo z panvice s mesiačikmi citróna.
steps.en: Cover the paella with a tea towel and rest for 5 minutes. Serve straight from the pan with lemon wedges.

title.sk: Fideuà s krevetami

description.sk: Valencijská „paella z cestovín“ s krevetami, rybou a cesnakovou majonézou.
description.en: Valencia's 'pasta paella' with prawns, fish and garlic mayonnaise.

steps.sk: Špagety nalámaj na kúsky dlhé asi 2 cm. Na širokej panvici zohrej 3 lyžice oleja a cestoviny opekaj na strednom ohni 4 minúty za stáleho miešania, kým nie sú zlatohnedé – dodá to orieškovú chuť.
steps.en: Break the spaghetti into pieces about 2 cm long. Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a wide pan and fry the pasta over a medium heat for 4 minutes, stirring constantly, until golden brown; this adds a nutty flavour.

steps.sk: Cestoviny presuň na tanier. Na panvici zohrej zvyšný olej a krevety opeč 1 minútu z každej strany, kým nezružovejú, a vyber ich. Bujón rozpusti v 750 ml horúcej vody.
steps.en: Move the pasta to a plate. Heat the remaining oil in the pan and fry the prawns for 1 minute per side until pink, then lift them out. Dissolve the stock cube in 750 ml of hot water.

steps.sk: Na panvicu daj nasekaný cesnak a nastrúhané paradajky, pridaj papriku a var 4 minúty. Vráť cestoviny, zalej vývarom a rozprestri ich. Var bez miešania 8 minút.
steps.en: Put the chopped garlic and grated tomatoes in the pan, add the paprika and cook for 4 minutes. Return the pasta, pour in the stock and spread it out. Simmer without stirring for 8 minutes.

steps.sk: Na cestoviny polož kúsky rybacieho mäsa a krevety, mierne ich zatlač a var ďalšie 4 minúty, kým cestoviny nevpijú tekutinu a ryba nie je biela. Cestoviny sa na okrajoch jemne zdvihnú.
steps.en: Lay the pieces of fish and the prawns on the pasta, press them in slightly and cook for another 4 minutes until the pasta has absorbed the liquid and the fish is white. The pasta curls up a little at the edges.

steps.sk: Majonézu zmiešaj s prelisovaným strúčikom cesnaku a kvapkou citróna. Fideuà podávaj hneď s cesnakovou majonézou a mesiačikmi citróna.
steps.en: Mix the mayonnaise with a crushed garlic clove and a squeeze of lemon. Serve the fideuà at once with the garlic mayonnaise and lemon wedges.

title.sk: Vyprážaný baklažán s medom

description.sk: Andalúzske tapas: tenké plátky baklažánu v chrumkavom obale, pokvapkané medom.
description.en: Andalusian tapas: thin aubergine slices in a crisp coating, drizzled with honey.

note.sk: toľko vsiakne; na vyprážanie priprav asi 400 ml
note.en: this much is absorbed; have about 400 ml for frying

steps.sk: Baklažány nakrájaj na kolieska alebo prúžky hrubé asi 5 mm. Namoč ich na 20 minút do mlieka so soľou – baklažán zmäkne, stratí horkosť a nasaje menej oleja.
steps.en: Cut the aubergines into rounds or sticks about 5 mm thick. Soak them for 20 minutes in the milk with the salt; the aubergine softens, loses any bitterness and soaks up less oil.

steps.sk: Plátky vyber z mlieka, nechaj odkvapkať a obaľ v múke, prebytočnú múku striasni.
steps.en: Lift the slices out of the milk, let them drain and toss them in the flour, shaking off the excess.

steps.sk: V hlbšej panvici rozpáľ olej na 180 °C – kúsok chleba v ňom zasyčí a do 30 sekúnd zozlatne. Vyprážaj baklažán po častiach 2 až 3 minúty, kým nie je zlatistý a chrumkavý.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a deep pan to 180 °C; a cube of bread should sizzle and turn golden within 30 seconds. Fry the aubergine in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and crisp.

steps.sk: Vyberaj ho na papierovú utierku, aby odkvapkal. Ulož na tanier, pokvapkaj medom a podľa chuti posyp rozmarínom. Podávaj hneď, kým je chrumkavý.
steps.en: Lift onto kitchen paper to drain. Arrange on a plate, drizzle with honey and sprinkle with rosemary if you like. Serve straight away while crisp.

title.sk: Pinchos morunos – korenené bravčové špízy

description.sk: Španielske špízy z bravčového mäsa marinovaného v rasci, paprike a cesnaku.
description.en: Spanish skewers of pork marinated in cumin, paprika and garlic.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kocky asi 2,5 cm. Zmiešaj olej, údenú papriku, rascu, koriander, oregano, prelisovaný cesnak, citrónovú šťavu a soľ a mäso v marináde dôkladne obaľ.
steps.en: Cut the pork into roughly 2.5 cm cubes. Mix the oil, smoked paprika, cumin, coriander, oregano, crushed garlic, lemon juice and salt and coat the meat thoroughly in the marinade.

steps.sk: Prikry a nechaj marinovať v chladničke aspoň 2 hodiny, najlepšie cez noc – korenie prenikne do mäsa. Drevené špajdle namoč na 20 minút do vody.
steps.en: Cover and marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours, ideally overnight, so the spices penetrate the meat. Soak wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 230 °C s grilom. Mäso napichaj na špajdle tesne vedľa seba a ulož ich na mriežku nad plech.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 230 °C with the grill on. Thread the meat tightly onto the skewers and lay them on a rack over a tray.

steps.sk: Griluj 10 až 12 minút, v polovici ich otoč, kým nie sú zvonku opečené a vo vnútri biele bez ružovej farby. Podávaj s chlebom a citrónom.
steps.en: Grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning halfway, until browned outside and white inside with no pink. Serve with bread and lemon.

title.sk: Patatas a lo pobre – zemiaky s paprikou a cibuľou
title.en: Patatas a lo pobre: potatoes with peppers and onions

description.sk: Pomaly opekané zemiaky s paprikou, cibuľou a cesnakom na olivovom oleji.
description.en: Potatoes slowly fried with peppers, onions and garlic in olive oil.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na tenké plátky asi 3 mm. Cibuľu nakrájaj na polkolieska, papriky na prúžky a cesnak na plátky.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and slice them thinly, about 3 mm. Cut the onions into half-moons, the peppers into strips and the garlic into slices.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici zohrej olej na strednom ohni, pridaj zemiaky, cibuľu a polovicu soli a premiešaj. Prikry pokrievkou a dus na miernom až strednom ohni 15 minút za občasného miešania, kým zemiaky nezmäknú.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large pan over a medium heat, add the potatoes, onions and half the salt and stir. Cover and cook over a medium-low heat for 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the potatoes soften.

steps.sk: Pridaj papriky a cesnak, odkry panvicu a zvýš oheň. Opekaj ďalších 12 až 15 minút a len občas obráť, kým zemiaky nie sú zlatisté s chrumkavými okrajmi a papriky mäkké.
steps.en: Add the peppers and garlic, uncover and turn up the heat. Fry for another 12 to 15 minutes, turning only occasionally, until the potatoes are golden with crisp edges and the peppers are soft.

steps.sk: Dochuť zvyšnou soľou a posyp vňaťou. Podávaj ako prílohu alebo ako hlavné jedlo s volskými okami navrchu.
steps.en: Season with the remaining salt and sprinkle with parsley. Serve as a side or as a main topped with fried eggs.

title.sk: Mandľový koláč Santiago

description.sk: Galícijský bezlepkový koláč z mandlí, vajec a cukru s citrónovou kôrou.
description.en: A gluten-free Galician cake of almonds, eggs and sugar with lemon zest.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C a formu s priemerom 22 cm vymasti maslom a dno vylož papierom. Ak nemáš mleté mandle, zomeľ celé v mixéri na jemnú múčku – nemixuj príliš dlho, pustili by olej.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C, grease a 22 cm tin and line the base. If you have no ground almonds, grind whole ones in a blender to a fine meal; do not blend too long or they release oil.

steps.sk: Vajcia vyšľahaj s cukrom 5 minút, kým zmes nie je svetlá, hustá a zdvojnásobí objem. Pridaj citrónovú kôru a škoricu.
steps.en: Whisk the eggs with the sugar for 5 minutes until pale, thick and doubled in volume. Add the lemon zest and cinnamon.

steps.sk: Mandle vmiešaj stierkou po častiach, zľahka, aby vajcia nestratili vzduch. Cesto vylej do formy a uhlaď.
steps.en: Fold in the almonds with a spatula a little at a time, gently, so the eggs keep their air. Pour the batter into the tin and level it.

steps.sk: Peč 35 až 40 minút, kým koláč nie je zlatohnedý a špajdľa zo stredu nevyjde čistá. Nechaj ho vychladnúť vo forme, potom ho vyber.
steps.en: Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until golden brown and a skewer from the centre comes out clean. Let it cool in the tin, then turn out.

steps.sk: Posyp práškovým cukrom – v Galícii sa cez papierovú šablónu vytvára kríž sv. Jakuba. Koláč vydrží v krabičke 5 dní a odležaním je vláčnejší.
steps.en: Dust with icing sugar; in Galicia a paper stencil is used to leave the cross of St James. The cake keeps in a tin for 5 days and gets moister as it rests.

title.sk: Caldo verde – portugalská polievka s kelom

description.sk: Krémová zemiaková polievka s tenkými prúžkami kelu a kolieskami chorizo.
description.en: A creamy potato soup with fine ribbons of kale and slices of chorizo.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky, cibuľu a cesnak nasekaj. V hrnci zohrej 2 lyžice oleja a cibuľu opekaj 5 minút, pridaj cesnak a zemiaky, zalej 1,2 litrom vody a pridaj bujón.
steps.en: Peel and dice the potatoes and chop the onion and garlic. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pot and fry the onion for 5 minutes, add the garlic and potatoes, pour in 1.2 litres of water and add the stock cube.

steps.sk: Var 15 až 20 minút, kým sa zemiaky nerozpadávajú. Medzitým odstráň z kelu tvrdé rebrá, listy zroluj do zväzku a nakrájaj ostrým nožom na čo najtenšie prúžky.
steps.en: Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes until the potatoes fall apart. Meanwhile strip the tough ribs from the kale, roll the leaves into a bundle and slice them with a sharp knife into the finest possible ribbons.

steps.sk: Polievku rozmixuj dohladka. Pridaj kel a var 4 až 5 minút, kým nezmäkne, ale zostane sýto zelený. Dochuť soľou a korením.
steps.en: Blend the soup until smooth. Add the kale and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes until tender but still deep green. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Chorizo nakrájaj na tenké kolieska a opeč na suchej panvici 2 minúty dochrumkava. Polievku nalej do misiek, navrch daj chorizo a pokvapkaj zvyšným olejom. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Slice the chorizo thinly and fry in a dry pan for 2 minutes until crisp. Ladle the soup into bowls, top with the chorizo and drizzle with the remaining oil. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Treska po portugalsky s vajcom a zemiakmi
title.en: Portuguese cod with egg and potato straws

description.sk: Inšpirované bacalhau à brás: treska, cibuľa, tenké zemiakové prúžky a krémové vajcia.
description.en: Inspired by bacalhau à brás: cod, onion, crisp potato straws and creamy eggs.

steps.sk: Tresku vlož do hrnca, zalej vodou s trochou soli a var na miernom ohni 5 minút, kým sa nezačne rozpadávať. Vyber ju, nechaj vychladnúť a rozober na lupienky, odstráň kosti a kožu.
steps.en: Put the cod in a pan, cover with lightly salted water and simmer gently for 5 minutes until it starts to flake. Lift it out, let it cool and flake it, removing any bones and skin.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na čo najtenšie hranolčeky, ako zápalky. Opláchni ich a dôkladne osuš. Na panvici rozpáľ 4 lyžice oleja a opekaj ich po častiach 5 až 6 minút dozlatista a dochrumkava, potom ich vyber na papier.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and cut them into the thinnest possible matchsticks. Rinse and dry them thoroughly. Heat 4 tablespoons of oil in a pan and fry them in batches for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and crisp, then drain on paper.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji opekaj cibuľu nakrájanú na tenké polkolieska 8 minút do mäkka a zlatista, pridaj cesnak. Vmiešaj rybu a polovicu zemiakov a zohrej ich.
steps.en: Fry the onions, sliced thinly into half-moons, in the remaining oil for 8 minutes until soft and golden, then add the garlic. Stir in the fish and half the potato straws and warm through.

steps.sk: Zníž oheň na minimum, vlej rozšľahané vajcia so soľou a korením a pomaly miešaj, kým vajcia nezačnú tuhnúť do krémovej hmoty – ešte majú byť lesklé. Hneď odstav.
steps.en: Turn the heat to the minimum, pour in the eggs beaten with the salt and pepper and stir slowly until they begin to set into a creamy mass; they should still be glossy. Take off the heat straight away.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj zvyšné zemiakové prúžky a nasekanú vňať, navrch rozlož olivy a podávaj hneď so zeleným šalátom.
steps.en: Fold in the remaining potato straws and the chopped parsley, top with the olives and serve at once with a green salad.

title.sk: Lomo en adobo – marinovaná bravčová krkovička

description.sk: Plátky bravčového mäsa marinované v údenej paprike, cesnaku a octe, opečené na panvici.
description.en: Pork slices marinated in smoked paprika, garlic and vinegar, then pan-fried.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na plátky hrubé asi 1 cm. Prelisovaný cesnak zmiešaj s údenou paprikou, oreganom, octom, 3 lyžicami oleja a soľou na hustú červenú pastu.
steps.en: Cut the pork into slices about 1 cm thick. Mix the crushed garlic with the smoked paprika, oregano, vinegar, 3 tablespoons of oil and the salt into a thick red paste.

steps.sk: Plátky obaľ zo všetkých strán marinádou, prikry a nechaj marinovať v chladničke aspoň 2 hodiny. Ocot mäso zjemní a paprika ho sfarbí.
steps.en: Coat the slices all over in the paste, cover and marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours. The vinegar tenderises the meat and the paprika colours it.

steps.sk: Zemiaky nakrájaj na kúsky a uvar alebo upeč. Papriku nakrájaj na prúžky. Na panvici rozpáľ zvyšný olej a papriku opeč 4 minúty, vyber ju.
steps.en: Cut the potatoes into chunks and boil or roast them. Cut the pepper into strips. Heat the remaining oil in a pan and fry the pepper for 4 minutes, then lift it out.

steps.sk: Plátky mäsa opekaj na strednom až vysokom ohni 2 až 3 minúty z každej strany, kým nie sú vo vnútri prepečené, bez ružovej farby. Paprika v marináde rýchlo hnedne, preto oheň nedávaj na maximum.
steps.en: Fry the pork slices over a medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until cooked through with no pink inside. The paprika in the marinade browns quickly, so do not use the highest heat.

steps.sk: Podávaj so zemiakmi a opečenou paprikou, polej šťavou z panvice. Studené mäso je výborné aj v sendviči.
steps.en: Serve with the potatoes and fried peppers, spooning over the pan juices. Cold, the meat is excellent in a sandwich.

title.sk: Šampiňóny na cesnaku po španielsky

description.sk: Tapas zo šampiňónov opečených s cesnakom, čili, petržlenovou vňaťou a citrónom.
description.en: Tapas of mushrooms fried with garlic, chilli, parsley and lemon.

steps.sk: Šampiňóny očisti kefkou a väčšie rozštvrť, menšie rozpoľ. Cesnak nakrájaj na tenké plátky, vňať nasekaj.
steps.en: Brush the mushrooms clean; quarter the larger ones and halve the small ones. Slice the garlic thinly and chop the parsley.

steps.sk: Na širokej panvici rozpáľ olej na vysokom ohni a šampiňóny opekaj 5 minút bez veľkého miešania, kým nie sú zlatohnedé. Ak ich je veľa, opekaj ich na dvakrát – natlačené by sa dusili.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pan over a high heat and fry the mushrooms for 5 minutes without much stirring until golden brown. If there are a lot, fry them in two batches; crowded mushrooms stew.

steps.sk: Zníž oheň, pridaj cesnak a čili a opekaj 1 minútu, kým cesnak nezavonia. Podlej vínom alebo 2 lyžicami vody a nechaj 1 minútu odparovať.
steps.en: Lower the heat, add the garlic and chilli and fry for 1 minute until the garlic is fragrant. Add the wine or 2 tablespoons of water and let it bubble for 1 minute.

steps.sk: Osoľ, pokvapkaj citrónom a posyp vňaťou. Podávaj v miske s chlebom na vytieranie cesnakového oleja.
steps.en: Season with salt, squeeze over the lemon and sprinkle with parsley. Serve in a dish with bread to mop up the garlic oil.

title.sk: Migas s chorizom a paprikou

description.sk: Pastierske jedlo zo Španielska: opečené kúsky chleba s cesnakom, chorizom a paprikou.
description.en: A Spanish shepherd's dish of fried bread crumbs with garlic, chorizo and pepper.

steps.sk: Chlieb nakrájaj alebo natrhaj na kúsky veľkosti lieskového orecha. Pokvapkaj ho 100 ml vody so štipkou soli, premiešaj a prikry utierkou – nechaj 15 minút, aby jemne zvlhol, ale nerozmočil sa.
steps.en: Cut or tear the bread into hazelnut-sized pieces. Sprinkle with 100 ml of water with a pinch of salt, toss and cover with a tea towel; leave for 15 minutes so it softens slightly without going soggy.

steps.sk: Chorizo a slaninu nakrájaj na kocky, papriku na prúžky a cesnak nechaj v celých strúčikoch, len ich rozpuč nožom. Na veľkej panvici zohrej olej a cesnak opekaj 2 minúty, potom ho vyber.
steps.en: Dice the chorizo and bacon, cut the pepper into strips and leave the garlic cloves whole, just crushing them with a knife. Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the garlic for 2 minutes, then lift it out.

steps.sk: Na voňavom oleji opekaj slaninu, chorizo a papriku 5 minút. Vyber ich na tanier a pridaj chlieb.
steps.en: Fry the bacon, chorizo and pepper in the garlicky oil for 5 minutes. Lift them onto a plate and add the bread.

steps.sk: Chlieb opekaj na strednom ohni 10 minút za stáleho miešania a rozbíjania vareškou, kým nie je zlatistý a chrumkavý. Vráť mäso, papriku a cesnak, posyp údenou paprikou a premiešaj.
steps.en: Fry the bread over a medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring and breaking it up constantly with a spoon, until golden and crisp. Return the meat, pepper and garlic, sprinkle with smoked paprika and toss.

steps.sk: Podávaj hneď, podľa chuti s volským okom navrchu alebo s hroznom, ako sa to robí na španielskom vidieku.
steps.en: Serve straight away, topped with a fried egg if you like or with grapes, the way it is done in the Spanish countryside.

title.sk: Bubble and squeak – zemiakové placky s kapustou a vajcom
title.en: Bubble and squeak with fried eggs

description.sk: Chrumkavé placky zo zemiakovej kaše a opečenej kapusty, podávané s volským okom.
description.en: Crisp cakes of mashed potato and fried cabbage, served with a fried egg.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na kusy a uvar v osolenej vode 15 až 18 minút do mäkka. Sceď ich, nechaj 2 minúty odpariť a roztlač s polovicou masla na hrubšiu kašu.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, cut into chunks and boil in salted water for 15 to 18 minutes until tender. Drain, let them steam dry for 2 minutes and mash with half the butter into a coarse mash.

steps.sk: Kapustu nakrájaj na tenké rezance a cibuľu nadrobno. Na zvyšnom masle ich opekaj 6 až 8 minút, kým kapusta nezmäkne a nezačne zlatnúť.
steps.en: Shred the cabbage finely and chop the onion. Fry them in the remaining butter for 6 to 8 minutes until the cabbage is soft and starting to colour.

steps.sk: Kapustu vmiešaj do zemiakov, dochuť zvyšnou soľou a korením a vytvaruj 8 placiek hrubých asi 2 cm. Zľahka ich obaľ v múke, aby držali tvar.
steps.en: Mix the cabbage into the potatoes, season with the remaining salt and the pepper and shape 8 cakes about 2 cm thick. Dust them lightly with flour so they hold their shape.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej olej a placky opekaj na strednom ohni 4 až 5 minút z každej strany, kým nemajú tmavozlatú chrumkavú kôrku. Neobracaj ich príliš skoro, rozpadli by sa.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the cakes over a medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes per side until they have a deep golden crisp crust. Do not turn them too early or they fall apart.

steps.sk: Na tej istej panvici priprav volské oká a podávaj ich na plackách. Placky sú výborné aj zo zvyškov pečenej zeleniny a vytvarované vydržia v chladničke 2 dni.
steps.en: Fry the eggs in the same pan and serve them on the cakes. The cakes are also great made from leftover roast vegetables, and once shaped they keep in the fridge for 2 days.

title.sk: Ploughman's – tanier so syrom, šunkou a jablkovým čatní

description.sk: Britský studený obed: cheddar, šunka, vajce, chlieb, zelenina a rýchle domáce jablkové čatní.
description.en: A British cold lunch: cheddar, ham, egg, bread, salad and a quick homemade apple chutney.

steps.sk: Na rýchle čatní ošúp jedno jablko a nakrájaj ho na drobné kocky, cibuľu nadrobno. Daj ich do hrnčeka s cukrom, octom, hrozienkami, zázvorom, soľou a 50 ml vody.
steps.en: For a quick chutney peel one apple and dice it small, and finely chop the onion. Put them in a small pan with the sugar, vinegar, raisins, ginger, salt and 50 ml of water.

steps.sk: Var na miernom ohni 20 minút a občas premiešaj, kým jablko nezmäkne a tekutina sa nezredukuje na hustý lesklý sirup. Nechaj vychladnúť, čatní ešte zhustne.
steps.en: Simmer gently for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the apple is soft and the liquid has reduced to a thick glossy syrup. Leave to cool; the chutney thickens further.

steps.sk: Vajcia uvar natvrdo 10 minút, ochlaď ich v studenej vode, ošúp a prekroj na polovice. Zvyšné jablká nakrájaj na mesiačiky až tesne pred podávaním, aby nezhnedli.
steps.en: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool them in cold water, peel and halve. Cut the remaining apples into wedges just before serving so they do not brown.

steps.sk: Cheddar nakrájaj na hrubé kusy, chlieb na krajce a uhorky pozdĺžne na štvrtiny. Šalát natrhaj a paradajky prekroj na polovice.
steps.en: Cut the cheddar into thick chunks, the bread into slices and the pickles lengthways into quarters. Tear the lettuce and halve the tomatoes.

steps.sk: Všetko poukladaj na veľkú dosku alebo na taniere: chlieb s maslom, syr, šunku, vajcia, zeleninu, jablká, čatní a horčicu. Zvyšné čatní vydrží v uzavretom pohári v chladničke 2 týždne.
steps.en: Arrange everything on a large board or on plates: bread and butter, cheese, ham, eggs, salad, apple, chutney and mustard. Leftover chutney keeps in a closed jar in the fridge for 2 weeks.

title.sk: Lancashire hotpot – mäso pod chrumkavými zemiakmi

description.sk: Pomaly pečené hovädzie s cibuľou a mrkvou pod strechou z tenkých plátkov zemiakov.
description.en: Slow-baked beef with onion and carrot under a roof of thinly sliced potatoes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 160 °C. Mäso nakrájaj na kocky 3 cm, obaľ v múke a po častiach ho opeč na oleji v hrnci vhodnom do rúry dohneda, každú dávku asi 4 minúty. Príliš veľa mäsa naraz by sa dusilo, nie opekalo.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 160 °C. Cut the beef into 3 cm cubes, toss in the flour and brown it in batches in the oil in an ovenproof pot, about 4 minutes per batch. Too much meat at once stews rather than browns.

steps.sk: K mäsu pridaj cibuľu nakrájanú na polkolieska a mrkvu na hrubé kolieska a opekaj 5 minút. Prilej 500 ml horúcej vody s bujónom a sójovou omáčkou, pridaj tymian, bobkové listy a soľ a premiešaj.
steps.en: Add the onions cut into half-moons and the carrots in thick rounds and fry for 5 minutes. Pour in 500 ml of hot water with the stock cube and soy sauce, add the thyme, bay leaves and salt and stir.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na plátky hrubé 3 mm. Poukladaj ich na mäso v prekrývajúcich sa vrstvách ako strešné škridly, potri rozpusteným maslom a okoreň.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and slice them 3 mm thick. Layer them over the meat, overlapping like roof tiles, brush with the melted butter and season with pepper.

steps.sk: Prikry pokrievkou a peč 1 a pol hodiny, kým mäso nezmäkne a šťava pod zemiakmi nezhustne.
steps.en: Cover with the lid and bake for 1½ hours until the meat is tender and the juices under the potatoes have thickened.

steps.sk: Odkry a peč ešte 40 minút, kým nie sú zemiaky navrchu zlatohnedé a chrumkavé. Nechaj 10 minút odpočívať a podávaj s dusenou červenou kapustou alebo hráškom. Vydrží v chladničke 3 dni.
steps.en: Uncover and bake for 40 more minutes until the potatoes on top are golden brown and crisp. Rest for 10 minutes and serve with braised red cabbage or peas. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Sendvič s domácimi rybími prstami a tatárskou omáčkou
title.en: Fish finger sandwich with tartare sauce

description.sk: Chrumkavé prsty z tresky v strúhanke s rýchlou tatárskou omáčkou a šalátom v mäkkom chlebe.
description.en: Crisp breaded cod fingers with a quick tartare sauce and lettuce in soft bread.

note.sk: toľko vsiakne; na vyprážanie priprav asi 300 ml
note.en: this much is absorbed; have about 300 ml for frying

steps.sk: Na tatársku omáčku nasekaj kapary a uhorku nadrobno a zmiešaj ich s majonézou, jogurtom a šťavou z polovice citróna. Daj ju do chladničky.
steps.en: For the tartare sauce finely chop the capers and pickle and mix with the mayonnaise, yogurt and the juice of half the lemon. Put it in the fridge.

steps.sk: Rybu osuš papierovou utierkou, nakrájaj na prsty široké asi 2 cm a osoľ. Priprav tri taniere: s múkou, s rozšľahaným vajcom a so strúhankou.
steps.en: Pat the fish dry with kitchen paper, cut into fingers about 2 cm wide and season with salt. Set out three plates: one with flour, one with beaten egg and one with breadcrumbs.

steps.sk: Každý kúsok obaľ najprv v múke, potom vo vajci a nakoniec v strúhanke, ktorú dobre pritlač. Obalené prsty nechaj 10 minút v chladničke, obal sa potom pri vyprážaní neodlúpne.
steps.en: Coat each piece first in flour, then in egg and finally in breadcrumbs, pressing them on well. Chill the coated fingers for 10 minutes so the coating does not come off during frying.

steps.sk: V panvici rozohrej olej asi 1 cm vysoko a rybie prsty vyprážaj na strednom ohni 2 až 3 minúty z každej strany, kým nie sú zlatohnedé a ryba vo vnútri biela a nerozpadá sa na lupienky. Nechaj ich odkvapkať na papierovej utierke.
steps.en: Heat the oil about 1 cm deep in a frying pan and fry the fish fingers over a medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden brown and the fish is white and flaky inside. Drain on kitchen paper.

steps.sk: Chlieb natri tatárskou omáčkou, poukladaj naň šalát a rybie prsty, pokvapkaj ich citrónom a prikry druhým krajcom. Podávaj hneď, kým je obal chrumkavý.
steps.en: Spread the bread with tartare sauce, top with lettuce and the fish fingers, squeeze over some lemon and cover with a second slice. Serve straight away while the coating is crisp.

title.sk: Eton mess – jahody so šľahačkou a pusinkami

description.sk: Britský letný dezert z jahôd, ľahkého krému a nalámaných domácich pusiniek.
description.en: A British summer dessert of strawberries, light cream and broken homemade meringues.

note.sk: 80 g do snehu, 20 g k jahodám
note.en: 80 g for the meringue, 20 g for the strawberries

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 120 °C a plech vystel papierom na pečenie. Bielky vyšľahaj do tuha, potom postupne po lyžiciach pridávaj 80 g cukru a šľahaj, kým nie je sneh hustý a lesklý a cukor sa úplne nerozpustí.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 120 °C and line a tray with baking paper. Whisk the egg whites until stiff, then add 80 g of sugar a spoonful at a time, whisking until the meringue is thick and glossy and the sugar has dissolved.

steps.sk: Nakoniec zľahka vmiešaj škrob a ocot. Sneh rozotri lyžicou na plech v kôpkach a peč 60 minút, potom rúru vypni a nechaj pusinky v nej vychladnúť ešte aspoň 30 minút.
steps.en: Finally fold in the cornflour and vinegar. Spoon the meringue onto the tray in mounds and bake for 60 minutes, then switch off the oven and leave the meringues inside to cool for at least 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Polovicu jahôd nakrájaj na štvrtiny a premiešaj s 20 g cukru. Zvyšné jahody roztlač vidličkou na hrubú omáčku.
steps.en: Quarter half the strawberries and toss with 20 g of sugar. Mash the rest with a fork into a coarse sauce.

steps.sk: Smotanu vyšľahaj s vanilkovým cukrom do polotuha a zľahka vmiešaj jogurt. Pusinky nalámaj na kúsky veľké ako orech.
steps.en: Whip the cream with the vanilla sugar to soft peaks and gently fold in the yogurt. Break the meringues into walnut-sized pieces.

steps.sk: Do pohárov vrstvi krém, pusinky, jahody a jahodovú omáčku a nakoniec ich zľahka premiešaj, aby vznikli ružové pruhy. Podávaj hneď, pusinky v kréme postupne mäknú; samotné vydržia v uzavretej dóze týždeň.
steps.en: Layer the cream, meringue, strawberries and strawberry sauce in glasses and swirl lightly to make pink ripples. Serve straight away, as the meringue softens in the cream; on their own the meringues keep in an airtight tin for a week.

title.sk: Chlebový puding s maslom a hrozienkami

description.sk: Krajce chleba s maslom a hrozienkami zapečené vo vanilkovom vaječnom kréme.
description.en: Buttered bread and raisins baked in a vanilla egg custard.

steps.sk: Zapekaciu misu s rozmermi asi 20 × 25 cm vymasti maslom. Krajce chleba natri zvyšným mäkkým maslom a prekroj ich na trojuholníky.
steps.en: Butter a baking dish of about 20 × 25 cm. Spread the slices of bread with the rest of the soft butter and cut them into triangles.

steps.sk: Trojuholníky ukladaj do misy šikmo a prekrývaj ich ako škridly, medzi ne rozsyp hrozienka. Rohy chleba nechaj vyčnievať, v rúre budú chrumkavé.
steps.en: Arrange the triangles in the dish at an angle, overlapping like tiles, scattering the raisins between them. Leave the corners of the bread sticking up; they turn crisp in the oven.

steps.sk: Mlieko so smotanou zohrej, kým nie je teplé, ale nevrie. Vajcia vyšľahaj s cukrom a vanilkovým cukrom a za stáleho miešania k nim prilej teplé mlieko. Prelej chlieb, posyp muškátovým orieškom a škoricou a nechaj 20 minút nasiaknuť.
steps.en: Warm the milk and cream until hot but not boiling. Whisk the eggs with the sugar and vanilla sugar and pour in the warm milk, whisking all the time. Pour over the bread, sprinkle with nutmeg and cinnamon and leave to soak for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 170 °C. Misu postav do väčšieho pekáča a do neho nalej horúcu vodu do polovice výšky misy, puding tak zostane krémový. Peč 35 až 40 minút, kým krém nestuhne a vyčnievajúce rohy chleba nie sú chrumkavé a zlaté.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 170 °C. Stand the dish in a larger roasting tin and pour hot water into the tin to halfway up the dish so the pudding stays creamy. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until the custard has set and the bread corners are crisp and golden.

steps.sk: Pre lesklý povrch ho potri zohriatym džemom. Podávaj teplý alebo vlažný. V chladničke vydrží 2 dni, porcie zohrievaj v mikrovlnke.
steps.en: For a glossy top brush it with warmed jam. Serve warm or lukewarm. It keeps in the fridge for 2 days; reheat portions in the microwave.

title.sk: Victoria sponge – piškótová torta s džemom a šľahačkou
title.en: Victoria sponge with jam and cream

description.sk: Dva nadýchané maslové korpusy spojené malinovým džemom a šľahačkou.
description.en: Two fluffy butter sponges sandwiched with raspberry jam and whipped cream.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C. Dve okrúhle formy s priemerom 20 cm vymasti maslom a dno vystel papierom na pečenie. Maslo a vajcia nechaj vopred zohriať na izbovú teplotu, inak sa cesto zrazí.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Butter two 20 cm round tins and line the bases with baking paper. Bring the butter and eggs to room temperature beforehand, otherwise the batter curdles.

steps.sk: Mäkké maslo vyšľahaj s cukrom a vanilkovým cukrom 4 až 5 minút do svetlej nadýchanej peny. Po jednom vmiešaj vajcia a po každom dobre vyšľahaj; ak by sa hmota začala zrážať, pridaj lyžicu múky.
steps.en: Beat the soft butter with the sugar and vanilla sugar for 4 to 5 minutes until pale and fluffy. Beat in the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each; if the mixture starts to curdle, add a spoonful of flour.

steps.sk: Preosej múku s práškom do pečiva a stierkou ju zľahka vmiešaj, nakoniec pridaj mlieko. Cesto rozdeľ rovnomerne do oboch foriem a uhlaď ho.
steps.en: Sift in the flour with the baking powder and fold in gently with a spatula, then add the milk. Divide the batter evenly between the tins and smooth the tops.

steps.sk: Peč 22 až 25 minút, kým nie sú korpusy zlatisté, pri dotyku pružia a špajľa vyjde čistá. Prvých 20 minút rúru neotváraj, cesto by spľaslo. Nechaj ich 5 minút vo forme, potom vyklop na mriežku a nechaj úplne vychladnúť.
steps.en: Bake for 22 to 25 minutes until golden, springy to the touch and a skewer comes out clean. Do not open the oven for the first 20 minutes or the sponges sink. Leave in the tins for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool completely.

steps.sk: Smotanu vyšľahaj do tuha. Spodný korpus natri džemom, navrch rozotri šľahačku a prikry druhým korpusom. Posyp práškovým cukrom. So šľahačkou skladuj tortu v chladničke a zjedz do 2 dní.
steps.en: Whip the cream until stiff. Spread the bottom sponge with jam, spread the cream over it and top with the second sponge. Dust with icing sugar. With the cream filling, keep the cake in the fridge and eat within 2 days.

title.sk: Coronation chicken – kuracie v kari majonéze s mangom

description.sk: Pošírované kuracie mäso v jemnej kari omáčke s mangom, hrozienkami a praženými mandľami.
description.en: Poached chicken in a mild curry dressing with mango, raisins and toasted almonds.

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia daj do hrnca, zalej ich studenou vodou, pridaj polovicu soli a priveď do varu. Stiahni oheň na minimum a nechaj ich pod pokrievkou jemne pošírovať 15 minút, kým nie sú v strede prepečené. Vychladnúť ich nechaj vo vode, zostanú šťavnaté.
steps.en: Put the chicken in a pot, cover with cold water, add half the salt and bring to the boil. Turn the heat right down and poach gently, covered, for 15 minutes until cooked through. Let it cool in the water so it stays juicy.

steps.sk: Kari korenie opraž na suchej panvici 30 sekúnd, kým nezavonia, a vysyp ho do misky. Na tej istej panvici opraž mandle 2 až 3 minúty dozlatista.
steps.en: Toast the curry powder in a dry pan for 30 seconds until fragrant and tip it into a bowl. Toast the almonds in the same pan for 2 to 3 minutes until golden.

steps.sk: Ku kari pridaj jogurt, majonézu, med, citrónovú šťavu a zvyšnú soľ a premiešaj. Mango nakrájaj na kocky a hrozienka krátko namoč v teplej vode a sceď.
steps.en: Add the yogurt, mayonnaise, honey, lemon juice and remaining salt to the curry powder and mix. Dice the mango and soak the raisins briefly in warm water, then drain.

steps.sk: Kuracie mäso natrhaj alebo nakrájaj na kúsky a premiešaj s omáčkou, mangom a hrozienkami. Ryžu uvar podľa návodu na obale a nechaj ju vychladnúť.
steps.en: Shred or chop the chicken and mix it with the dressing, mango and raisins. Cook the rice according to the packet and let it cool.

steps.sk: Podávaj na listoch šalátu s ryžou, posypané mandľami a koriandrom, alebo ako plnku do sendvičov. Kuracie v omáčke vydrží v chladničke 2 dni.
steps.en: Serve on lettuce leaves with the rice, scattered with the almonds and coriander, or use as a sandwich filling. The dressed chicken keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

title.sk: Mulligatawny – anglo-indická šošovicová polievka

description.sk: Krémová kari polievka z červenej šošovice, mrkvy a jablka s kokosovým mliekom a ryžou, vegánska.
description.en: A creamy curried soup of red lentils, carrot and apple with coconut milk and rice, vegan.

steps.sk: V hrnci zohrej olej a nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu, mrkvu a stopkový zeler opekaj na strednom ohni 8 minút do mäkka. Pridaj nastrúhaný zázvor, nasekaný cesnak, kari a paradajkový pretlak a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pot and fry the finely chopped onion, carrots and celery over a medium heat for 8 minutes until soft. Add the grated ginger, chopped garlic, curry powder and tomato paste and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj ošúpané jablko nakrájané na kocky, prepláchnutú šošovicu a 1,2 litra horúcej vody s bujónom. Priveď do varu a var na miernom ohni 20 minút, kým sa šošovica úplne nerozvarí.
steps.en: Add the peeled and diced apple, the rinsed lentils and 1.2 litres of hot water with the stock cube. Bring to the boil and simmer gently for 20 minutes until the lentils have completely broken down.

steps.sk: Medzitým uvar ryžu podľa návodu na obale a nechaj ju prikrytú, kým nebude polievka hotová; ryža sa podáva priamo v miske pod polievkou.
steps.en: Meanwhile cook the rice according to the packet and keep it covered until the soup is ready; the rice goes straight into the bowls under the soup.

steps.sk: Polievku rozmixuj ponorným mixérom dohladka, vlej kokosové mlieko a prehrej ju, ale nevar. Dochuť citrónovou šťavou; ak je príliš hustá, prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Blend the soup with a stick blender until smooth, pour in the coconut milk and heat through without boiling. Season with lemon juice; if it is too thick, add a little water.

steps.sk: Do misiek daj lyžicu ryže, zalej ju polievkou a posyp nasekaným koriandrom. Polievka vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a bez ryže sa dá zamraziť.
steps.en: Put a spoonful of rice in each bowl, ladle the soup over it and sprinkle with chopped coriander. The soup keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes well without the rice.

title.sk: Cranachan – škótsky dezert s malinami a praženými vločkami
title.en: Cranachan: Scottish raspberry and toasted oat dessert

description.sk: Vrstvy medového krému, malín a karamelizovaných ovsených vločiek v pohári.
description.en: Layers of honeyed cream, raspberries and caramelised toasted oats in a glass.

steps.sk: Vločky opraž na suchej panvici na strednom ohni 4 až 5 minút, často miešaj, kým nie sú zlatisté a nevoňajú orieškovo. Posyp ich hnedým cukrom, minútu miešaj, kým sa cukor neroztopí, a vysyp ich na tanier vychladnúť.
steps.en: Toast the oats in a dry pan over a medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until golden and nutty. Sprinkle with the brown sugar, stir for a minute until it melts and tip onto a plate to cool.

steps.sk: Tretinu malín roztlač vidličkou s lyžicou medu na hrubú omáčku, zvyšné maliny nechaj celé. Mrazené maliny nechaj vopred rozmraziť a sceď z nich šťavu, inak by bol dezert vodnatý.
steps.en: Mash a third of the raspberries with a spoonful of honey into a coarse sauce and leave the rest whole. Thaw frozen raspberries first and drain off the juice, otherwise the dessert turns watery.

steps.sk: Smotanu vyšľahaj do polotuha, vmiešaj zvyšný med a jogurt a nakoniec väčšinu vychladnutých vločiek.
steps.en: Whip the cream to soft peaks, fold in the remaining honey and the yogurt and finally most of the cooled oats.

steps.sk: Do pohárov vrstvi krém, malinovú omáčku a celé maliny a navrch daj zvyšné vločky a pár malín. Podávaj do hodiny, vločky v kréme postupne mäknú.
steps.en: Layer the cream, raspberry sauce and whole raspberries in glasses and top with the remaining oats and a few berries. Serve within an hour, as the oats soften in the cream.

title.sk: Welsh cakes – waleské koláčiky z panvice

description.sk: Maslové koláčiky s hrozienkami a škoricou, opečené nasucho na panvici.
description.en: Buttery griddle cakes with raisins and cinnamon, cooked in a dry pan.

steps.sk: V mise zmiešaj múku, prášok do pečiva, škoricu, muškátový oriešok a soľ. Pridaj studené maslo nakrájané na kocky a rozotri ho prstami na jemné drobky.
steps.en: In a bowl mix the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt. Add the cold butter in cubes and rub it in with your fingertips to fine crumbs.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj cukor a hrozienka, pridaj rozšľahané vajce a mlieko a rýchlo vypracuj pevné cesto ako na krehké pečivo. Nemies ho dlho, koláčiky by stvrdli.
steps.en: Stir in the sugar and raisins, add the beaten egg and milk and quickly bring together into a firm dough like shortcrust. Do not knead it for long or the cakes turn hard.

steps.sk: Cesto rozvaľkaj na pomúčenej doske na hrúbku 5 mm a vykrajuj kolieska s priemerom 6 cm. Zvyšky znova spoj, rozvaľkaj a vykrajuj, kým cesto neminieš.
steps.en: Roll the dough out 5 mm thick on a floured board and cut out 6 cm rounds. Press the trimmings together, roll out again and cut more until the dough is used up.

steps.sk: Rozohrej panvicu s hrubým dnom na miernom až strednom ohni bez tuku a koláčiky opekaj 3 minúty z každej strany, kým nie sú zlatohnedé a vo vnútri prepečené. Ak tmavnú príliš rýchlo, zmierni oheň.
steps.en: Heat a heavy-based frying pan over a medium-low heat without fat and cook the cakes for 3 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. If they darken too fast, lower the heat.

steps.sk: Podávaj ich teplé alebo vychladnuté, samotné alebo s maslom a džemom. V uzavretej dóze vydržia 4 dni a dajú sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Serve warm or cooled, on their own or with butter and jam. They keep for 4 days in an airtight tin and freeze well.

title.sk: Sausage rolls – bravčové rolky v lístkovom ceste

description.sk: Lístkové cesto plnené korenistým mletým bravčovým s jablkom a tymianom, upečené dozlata.
description.en: Puff pastry filled with seasoned minced pork with apple and thyme, baked golden.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C a plech vystel papierom na pečenie. Cibuľu a ošúpané jablko nastrúhaj čo najjemnejšie a rukami z nich vytlač šťavu, aby plnka nebola vodnatá.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and line a tray with baking paper. Grate the onion and peeled apple as finely as you can and squeeze out the juice with your hands so the filling is not watery.

steps.sk: Mäso zmiešaj s cibuľou, jablkom, strúhankou, tymianom, horčicou, muškátovým orieškom, soľou a korením a dôkladne prehnet rukami, kým hmota nie je súdržná.
steps.en: Mix the pork with the onion, apple, breadcrumbs, thyme, mustard, nutmeg, salt and pepper and work it thoroughly with your hands until it holds together.

steps.sk: Lístkové cesto rozvaľkaj a pozdĺžne ho rozkroj na dva pásy. Na stred každého pásu polož polovicu plnky vo forme valčeka, jeden okraj potri vajcom, preklop cesto cez plnku a spoj zatlač vidličkou.
steps.en: Unroll the pastry and cut it lengthways into two strips. Lay half the filling along the middle of each strip in a sausage shape, brush one edge with egg, fold the pastry over the filling and press the seam with a fork.

steps.sk: Rolky otoč spojom nadol a každú nakrájaj na 6 kúskov. Potri ich vajcom, posyp sezamom a na vrchu každého urob dva malé zárezy, aby mohla unikať para.
steps.en: Turn the rolls seam side down and cut each into 6 pieces. Brush with egg, sprinkle with sesame and make two small slits in the top of each so the steam can escape.

steps.sk: Peč 25 až 30 minút, kým nie je cesto nafúknuté a tmavozlaté a mäso vo vnútri prepečené, bez ružovej farby. Podávaj teplé aj studené; v chladničke vydržia 3 dni a nepečené sa dajú zamraziť.
steps.en: Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until the pastry is puffed and deep golden and the pork is cooked through with no pink. Serve warm or cold; they keep in the fridge for 3 days and can be frozen unbaked.

title.sk: Cullen skink – škótska polievka s údenou rybou
title.en: Cullen skink: Scottish smoked fish soup

description.sk: Hustá mliečna polievka so zemiakmi, pórom a údenou makrelou, podávaná s chlebom.
description.en: A thick milky soup with potatoes, leek and smoked mackerel, served with bread.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozpusti maslo a nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu s pórom na tenké kolieska opekaj na miernom ohni 8 minút, kým nezmäknú, ale nezhnednú.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a pot and gently fry the finely chopped onion and the leek in thin rounds over a low heat for 8 minutes until soft but not browned.

steps.sk: Pridaj zemiaky nakrájané na kocky 1,5 cm, 400 ml vody a bobkový list, prikry a var 15 minút, kým nie sú zemiaky mäkké.
steps.en: Add the potatoes cut into 1.5 cm cubes, 400 ml of water and the bay leaf, cover and simmer for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.

steps.sk: Makrelu zbav kože a kostí a natrhaj ju na lupienky. Polovicu zemiakov roztlač varechou o stenu hrnca, polievka tak zhustne a bude krémová.
steps.en: Remove the skin and bones from the mackerel and flake it. Crush half the potatoes against the side of the pot with a wooden spoon so the soup thickens and turns creamy.

steps.sk: Vlej mlieko, pridaj makrelu a zohrievaj na miernom ohni 5 minút, ale nevar, mlieko by sa zrazilo a ryba by sa rozpadla na kašu. Soľ nepridávaj, údená ryba je dosť slaná.
steps.en: Pour in the milk, add the mackerel and heat gently for 5 minutes without boiling, or the milk curdles and the fish turns to mush. Do not add salt; the smoked fish is salty enough.

steps.sk: Okoreň, posyp nasekanou pažítkou a podávaj s krajcom chleba. Polievka vydrží v chladničke 2 dni, prehrievaj ju pomaly.
steps.en: Season with pepper, sprinkle with chopped chives and serve with a slice of bread. The soup keeps in the fridge for 2 days; reheat it gently.

title.sk: Glamorgan klobásky zo syra a póru

description.sk: Waleské vegetariánske klobásky zo strúhanky, cheddaru a póru, opečené do chrumkava.
description.en: Welsh vegetarian sausages of breadcrumbs, cheddar and leek, fried until crisp.

steps.sk: Pór nakrájaj na veľmi tenké kolieska a dus ho na masle pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 8 minút, kým nie je mäkký. Nechaj ho vychladnúť.
steps.en: Slice the leek very thinly and sweat it in the butter, covered, over a low heat for 8 minutes until soft. Let it cool.

steps.sk: Chlieb rozmixuj na strúhanku a zmiešaj s nastrúhaným syrom, pórom, nasekanou petržlenovou vňaťou, tymianom a korením. Pridaj jedno vajce, žĺtok z druhého a horčicu a premiešaj na súdržnú hmotu; ak je suchá, pridaj mlieko.
steps.en: Blitz the bread into crumbs and mix with the grated cheese, leek, chopped parsley, thyme and pepper. Add one egg, the yolk of the second and the mustard and mix into a firm mixture; if it is dry, add the milk.

steps.sk: Vytvaruj 8 klobások dlhých asi 10 cm. Zvyšný bielok rozšľahaj s lyžicou vody, klobásky v ňom obaľ a potom ich obaľ v suchej strúhanke. Nechaj ich 15 minút stuhnúť v chladničke.
steps.en: Shape 8 sausages about 10 cm long. Beat the remaining egg white with a spoonful of water, dip the sausages in it and then roll them in the dry breadcrumbs. Chill for 15 minutes to firm up.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej olej a klobásky opekaj na strednom ohni 8 až 10 minút, často ich obracaj, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán zlatohnedé a vo vnútri horúce.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the sausages over a medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning often, until golden brown all over and hot inside.

steps.sk: Paradajky prekroj a premiešaj s nadrobno nakrájanou cibuľou. Klobásky podávaj s týmto šalátom alebo so zemiakovou kašou. Vydržia v chladničke 2 dni a dajú sa zamraziť surové.
steps.en: Halve the tomatoes and toss with the finely chopped onion. Serve the sausages with this salad or with mashed potatoes. They keep in the fridge for 2 days and can be frozen uncooked.

title.sk: Citrónová bábovka s polevou (lemon drizzle)

description.sk: Vláčny maslový koláč, ktorý ešte horúci nasiakne citrónovým sirupom a vytvorí chrumkavú cukrovú kôrku.
description.en: A moist butter cake soaked while hot with lemon syrup that sets into a crunchy sugar crust.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 175 °C a podlhovastú formu s dĺžkou asi 25 cm vymasti a vystel papierom na pečenie. Z citrónov najemno nastrúhaj kôru a vytlač z nich šťavu.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 175 °C and grease and line a loaf tin about 25 cm long with baking paper. Finely grate the zest of the lemons and squeeze the juice.

steps.sk: Mäkké maslo vyšľahaj s cukrom a kôrou do svetlej peny a po jednom vmiešaj vajcia. Preosej múku s práškom do pečiva a vmiešaj ju spolu s mliekom na hladké cesto.
steps.en: Beat the soft butter with the sugar and zest until pale and fluffy, then beat in the eggs one at a time. Sift in the flour with the baking powder and fold in with the milk to a smooth batter.

steps.sk: Cesto vlej do formy, uhlaď ho a peč 45 až 50 minút, kým nie je zlatohnedé a špajľa zapichnutá do stredu nevyjde suchá.
steps.en: Pour the batter into the tin, smooth the top and bake for 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown and a skewer inserted in the centre comes out dry.

steps.sk: Kým je koláč ešte horúci, prepichaj ho špajľou na mnohých miestach. Práškový cukor zmiešaj s citrónovou šťavou na riedku polevu a pomaly ju lej na koláč, aby vsiakla do dierok.
steps.en: While the cake is still hot, prick it all over with a skewer. Mix the icing sugar with the lemon juice into a runny glaze and pour it slowly over the cake so it soaks into the holes.

steps.sk: Koláč nechaj vychladnúť vo forme, cukor na povrchu medzitým stuhne na chrumkavú kôrku. Zabalený vydrží 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Let the cake cool in the tin while the sugar on top sets into a crunchy crust. Wrapped, it keeps for 4 days and freezes well.
